recognize_zh: 周邊血液（A–C）可見中小型異型淋巴球，核不規則、有凹陷或花瓣/腎形核（箭頭），組織切片（D）為中小型細胞瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色（E、F）呈強陽性，符合以白血病表現的 ALK 陽性 ALCL 小細胞變異型。面板未標註抗體名稱。
features: Peripheral blood with circulating small to medium atypical lymphoid cells (A-C)
Irregular, indented, reniform or cloverleaf-like nuclei with condensed chromatin; arrows highlight nuclear notching/indentation
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm in some cells; occasional smudged cell and platelet clump
Tissue section (D): diffuse infiltrate of predominantly small to medium cells
IHC (E): strong cytoplasmic/membranous staining in many cells, accentuated in larger cells; (F): diffuse nuclear staining in most cells (antibodies not labeled)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show circulating small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to reniform or flower-like nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. The accompanying tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate composed predominantly of small to medium cells rather than sheets of large anaplastic cells. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong cytoplasmic/membranous reactivity in the infiltrate and a diffuse nuclear stain in most cells; the specific antibodies are not labeled in this figure. In the stated context, findings are consistent with the small cell variant of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma with leukemic presentation.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are HTLV-1 associated and CD25+ but ALK-negative and usually CD30 weak or negative in small cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei and are CD4+ CD7-/CD26- without ALK expression or CD30 in larger perivascular cells.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs and show TCL1A overexpression without ALK.
PTCL-NOS lacks ALK and the perivascular CD30+ ALK+ large hallmark cells of the small cell variant.
